title: U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program accepts a POST request from an unauthenticated user,…
description: The U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program had a vulnerability allowing unauthenticated users to send POST requests to a specific endpoint that could delete specified users. This flaw did not require authentication or cookies, posing a high risk of denial of service through user deletion. The issue was fixed on or around October 19, 2026.
